appearances.headline: TorchTPU brings native PyTorch to Google TPUs
appearances.newly_possible: Teams can run existing PyTorch code on TPUs with eager execution, torch.compile, vLLM or SGLang serving and TorchTitan training, with minimal changes.
appearances.why: It removes the main switching cost that kept PyTorch shops on GPUs, opening TPUs as a real compute option.
appearances.limits: no public performance numbers versus GPUs in the input
